Subject: Configurator workshop request — tier choice & feature mapping

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The leadership team at NimbleRx wants a short, focused workshop to lock the package for our pilot (60-day trial -> potential annual commit).

Primary asks:
- We need clear guidance on which tier to start with given our mix (50k monthly inference tokens, heavy embedding usage for search).
- Understand upgrade/downgrade mechanics and proration (we cannot be surprised by stepdown costs).
- A recommended feature bundle: which add-ons are critical for 1st phase vs can be delayed to v2.

Availability: any 60–90 minute slot this week except Thu afternoon PST. Could you also share a one-page summary of the stepdown/backout policy and the latest proposal PDF before the workshop?

Attaching: N/A (we will review the updated proposal you mentioned).

Best,

NimbleRx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Li <grace.li@nimble-rx.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimble-rx.com
Date: 2027-06-18T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Configurator workshop request — tier choice & feature mapping

Grace — thanks for the clear asks. Proposed plan below and a couple of options so we can make the workshop productive. I attached a short proposal and a one-sheet decision workbook ("Configurator-decision-sheet.xlsx").

Quick recommendation (based on usage snapshot you shared):
- Start: Core tier + Feature Pack (balanced throughput + medium feature set). Rationale: your embedding-heavy search will benefit from the Feature Pack (embedding refresh cache + reranking hooks) while Core keeps unit cost reasonable.
- Alternative (lower cost): Compact tier + Feature Pack (saves ~30% vs Core, lower concurrent throughput). Good if peak latency variability is acceptable.
- Upgrade path: Compact -> Core -> Throughput (no infra migration from our side); you keep the same account and we scale capacity.
- Downgrade/stepdown: 30-day notice; unused committed capacity prorated as credit toward future usage. If stepping down from Throughput to Core we recommend a 60-day buffer for KV-cache warming before full stepdown (to avoid transient latency spikes).

Pricing (illustrative, final numbers in attached PDF):
- Compact: $5,000 / month (list)
- Core: $12,000 / month (list)
- Throughput: $18,500 / month (list)
- Feature Pack add-on: $4,000 / month

Discounting options we can offer (requires sales approval):
- Annual commit (12 months) => 12% off list on total ARR.
- Fast-upgrade incentive: if NimbleRx signs an annual commit within 30 days of pilot, we can extend a 15% one-time add-on discount for Feature Pack in months 1–6.
- Procurement concession: small signing credit (one month free) for standard T&Cs + expedited PO.

Workshop agenda (60–90m):
1) Usage & SLO review (10m)
2) Walk through three scenario bundles and costs (20m)
3) Decision workbook live: pick starting tier, add-ons, and upgrade triggers (25m)
4) Next steps / SOW timeline / procurement checklist (15m)

Proposed times: Wed 10:00–11:30 PST or Fri 09:00–10:30 PST. Which works?

Attachments: NimbleRx-proposal-v2.pdf, Configurator-decision-sheet.xlsx

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Priyom — Wed 10:00 PST works. Please lock the invite and include Lauren and Ben if helpful. A few follow-ups ahead of the workshop:

1) Can you add a short bullet list in the PDF about the practical differences between Compact->Core upgrades (e.g., expected latency delta, queueing behavior, recommended cache warm-up steps)?
2) For the stepdown policy: confirm whether credits are applied automatically to the next invoice or require an amendment to the contract. We prefer automatic crediting to avoid extra PO cycles.
3) Please share the SOW draft (we want to start legal review ASAP) — labelled SOW-draft.docx if you already have one.

Procurement note: procurement@nimble-rx.com asked whether a 60-day pilot can be set up as a paid pilot with month-to-month billing, then converted to annual with pro-rated credits for the pilot months.

If you can add the requested bullets and the SOW draft to the invite, we’ll be in good shape. Looking forward to Wed.

Best,
Grace
